fix_plan.description: Minimal surgical fix for ValueError: No scheme supplied in webhook notification target URL

files_to_modify.rationale: Strict urlparse fails to prepend https:// on schemeless target URLs

fix_plan.patch:
--- a/app/services/webhook_service.py
+++ b/app/services/webhook_service.py
@@ -10,6 +10,8 @@
     """Validate and normalize outbound webhook endpoint URL."""
+    if not target_url.startswith(('http://', 'https://')):
+        target_url = f"https://{target_url}"
     parsed = urlparse(target_url)
     if not parsed.scheme:
         raise ValueError(f"Invalid URL '{target_url}': No scheme supplied. Perhaps you meant https://{target_url}?")
fix_plan.rationale: Strict urlparse fails to prepend https:// on schemeless target URLs
